Gravel Pit Station is a station on Swift Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Downtown. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 210 (Gravel Pit NR Station Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • Exits C, D and E of this station adopts the Exit Style of New Edward Line stations at the Twenty-Second Continent with regards that the stairs and elevator exits are integrated. Moreover, all exits of this station feature elevators.
  • Light Gray and Gray Terracotta are used to allude to the color gray which is usually associated with gravel.[2]

History[]

  • The station is a result of merging two stations: Deepond Hospital Station and Gravies Station. The latter one was planned to locate at the south Kamibara Shrine.

The name of Closouth Heights Station originates from the Hill located near this station, whereas this station is named after a Large Corroded Cave beneath the Mountain. In this sense, the two station names describe the terrain from the broad and narrow senses respectively.

title: Great City Railway
safeHtml:
Great City Railway, abbreviated as GCR, is one of the operators involved in the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme. It took part in development in Periods 1 and 3 of the Co-Op Railway. However, on May 21 2021, due to historical reasons, the owner of this railway was banned from Project Nazca, and the lines that it operated were handed over to other companies as a result. Nonetheless, following the unban of this railway from Project Nazca, it once again became a developer of the Co-Op Railway during the Continuous Development Phase.

Contents

  • 1 Former Operations
    • 1.1 Railway
  • 2 Current Operations
  • 3 Gallery
  • 4 Citations and References

Former Operations[]

Railway[]

  • Bonyal to Cyan Loop Line: A line built in Period 1 of the Co-Op Railway. Handed over to Phantasia Metro.
  • OasisPaw Line: A line built in Period 3 of the Co-Op Railway. Briefly handed over to Traveler City Transit Railway before being handed over to Phantasia Metro.

Current Operations[]

  • Lakebound Line: A line built in the Continuous Development Phase of the Co-Op Railway. It runs between Lake Lane and Sapporo Street SLT.

Station Gauntlet Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1.5
  • The left shows the hints to the road, whereas the right is the hidden road that leads to the Gauntlet.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a block of stone.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the first Area Station to be built in Los Sengas Division.
  • This station is the first station in Los Sengas and Los Sengas Division to adopt "SignPicutre" signs.
  • The design of Kelper Mount Station pays tribute to this station.

History[]

  • March 16 2015: This station began services. West Ring Line is established.
  • December 19 2015: This station completed upgrading Platform Screen Door flashing lights.
  • January 23 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[3]
  • December 13 2016: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[4]
  • January 22 2017: This station completed replacement of Welcome signs.[5]
  • February 24 2017: The Departure Routine has upgraded from Generation II to Generation III.[6]
  • March 29 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.
  • March 23 2020: This station completed upgrading signs to "SignPicture" signs.[7]
  • May 6 2021: Exit F is added to this station.[8]
  • January 8 2022: The Station Banners and the "Station Gauntlet" of this station are set up.[9]
  • June 4 2022: Exit E of this station is relocated to the north.[10]
  • April 16 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • February 19 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[11]
  • July 1 2025: The Station Icon of this station is added.

Fun Facts[]

  • Due to the usage of Blocks of Emerald at this station, two Parterres are placed at the Concourse to get views of Green.
  • For the lavatories at this station, the Female Lavatory is placed further from the concourse than the Male Lavatory. This is for the convenience of female passengers as female lavatories tend to have longer queues than male lavatories. When the female lavatory is placed further from the concourse, the queue has a lower probability of obstructing passenger flow from the concoruse to the platforms.[2]

Grensis Island Station is a station on Northland Line. It is operated by Peckern Transit, and is located on Grensis Island. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nazca Railway Interisland Line (Grensis Island Station) and Grensis Light Rail Transit Grassforest Line (Sandcave Station).

However, following redevelopment of Grensis Island, it is now instead connected to Sandcave Station of the Grensis Light Rail Transit, where access to the rest of the island, as well as to the ground level, is provided.

  • Stars: 0
  • Find a shop that looks different from all the others.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of powered rail.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the first station to be built at the Peckern Continent in Los Sengas Division.
  • The Expo Line Double junction is located at 100 m to the east of this station.

History[]

  • July 7 2015: This station began services alongside West Ring Line.
  • May 31 2016: The NR Shops at this station opened for renting.[2]
  • June 1 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[3]
  • February 25 2017: This station completed expansion of the Expo Line Part.
  • March 2 2017: The Expo Line part of this station began services. Expo Line extended from LSWorld-Expo Station to this station. Expo Line is established.[4]
  • January 25 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • December 2 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[6]

Fun Facts[]

  • The design of this Station alludes to the Sava Line Phase 1 Stations between Lake Lane Station and Savanna Central Station.[2] Red Wool is used in this station due to the fact that it had not been used at these stations. Moreover, the red color alludes to the Mastiff Shotgun in Apex Legends as shotguns are labeled as red in that game.
  • This Station is the last station to undergo expansion in 2024.

History[]

  • May 29 2021: This Station began construction.[3]
  • May 30 2021: This Station completed construction.[4] At the same day, this station began services alongside Sava Line.
  • December 29 2024: This station began expansion.
  • December 30 2024: This station completed expansion.
  • December 31 2024: Flask Line extends from Peacean Island Station to this station.

title: Hai-Kau River
safeHtml:
Hai-Kau River is a natural river in Deepond Island.

Desscription[]

Hai-Kau River flows from Deepond to the sea of West Metropolis Archipelago. This river has two estuaries, one in the east and one in the north. The east estuary flows from the north of Deepond to Hai Kau, East Pond and East Coast. After merging with Lighthouse River it reaches East Pond Bay. The north estuary flows into North Sand Bay.

Hakeem Island is one of the islands involved in the Centopia Nazca Railway Headquarters. Similar to Centopia Island and the other islands in Centopia, this island is also artificial.

Contents

  • 1 Location
  • 2 Transport
    • 2.1 Railway
    • 2.2 Road
  • 3 Fun Facts
  • 4 Future Development
  • 5 History
  • 6 Citations and References

Location[]

Hakeem Island is located to the northwest of Centopia Island, the north of Orama Island and the east of Relish Island.

Transport[]

Railway[]

This island features Hakeem Station of the Sparkling Line.

Road[]

Currently, this island features a main road connecting to Relish Island to the west and Centopia Island to the east, as well as a branch road connecting to Orama Island to the south.

In terms of roads within the island, a road runs along the southern perimeter of this island and ends with roundabouts at both the west and east ends. It runs under the branch road leading to Orama Island in the middle of this island directly to the south of Hakeem Station, and is connected to the main road by two different north-south oriented dual carriageways. Moreover, a Parking Lot is also built to the southeast of Hakeem Station.

Fun Facts[]

  • The name of this island Hakeem is taken from the Arabic language, and corresponds to the Chinese Name of this island, which means "Wise".[2]

Future Development[]

Prior to the construction of Hakeem Station on this island, it was already announced that the station would be connected to a school surrounding the station, and when combined with the Chinese Name of this island, Wise, it implies that educational facilities may be built on this island in the future.

History[]

  • October 27 2023: This island completed reclamation works.
  • November 3 2023: The road link to Centopia Island completed construction.
  • November 19 2023: Hakeem Station began services. At the same day, the road link to Orama Island completed construction.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Color scheme of this station alludes to Dansein Market Station.
  • This station features a large-scaled Exit Banner at the exit similar to that of Pinestand Station and Apple Hill Station. A similar Exit Banner would also be seen at Summer Point Gateway, Kivotos Station and Branches' Hallow Station.
  • The Ceiling Height of this station is approximately 90 feet tall, measured from Y=63 (Ground Level) to the ceiling height of Y=89.[2]

title: Halozy
safeHtml:
Halozy is one of the Sub-Districts of Twenty-Second Continent. It is currently under development.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Geography
  • 3 Housing Estates
    • 3.1 Fairscene Park
    • 3.2 Ying Lam Estate
    • 3.3 Skyline Serenade
  • 4 Facilities
  • 5 Major Roads
  • 6 Transport
    • 6.1 Nazca Railway
  • 7 Future Development
  • 8 Citations and References

History[]

Halozy is named after a Japanese Doujin Circle of the same name. Development plans were drafted on January 7 2020, and development began on the same day. The main purpose of Halozy Development is to balance the number of public and private housing in Twenty-Second Continent, therefore Halozy has a lower number of public housing than the rest of Twenty-Second Continent. (Public:Private Housing = 2:8)

Geography[]

Halozy mainly consists of desert terrain, and fluctuations in height are larger. Therefore, most of the developed land are derived from landscaping works.

Housing Estates[]

Fairscene Park[]

Fairscene Park is the first Housing Estate in Halozy. Fairscene Park provides 7'296 housing flats in its 24 buildings. The layout of the buildings forms a large space in the middle for shopping malls and public facilities. Currently, there is a Shopping Mall that provides daily necessities for its residents. For recreational facilities, there are 4 basketball courts, 2 football courts and a swimming pool that is open for its residents only.

Ying Lam Estate[]

Ying Lam Estate is the only Public Housing Estate planned in Halozy. Its 8 buildings provide a total of 5'120 housing flats.

Skyline Serenade[]

Skyline Serenade is an integrated housing project. Phase I of Skyline Serenade has a total of ten 44-storey buildings. Phase II features a 20-storey residential building, whereas Phase III has 54 independent buildings. However, green belts are also reserved within the planning feature of houses, and a 40-shop shopping street is also constructed in Phase III.

Facilities[]

Currently, Halozy has two secondary schools:

  • Serenade Road Secondary School
  • St. Peter Secondary School

And Two Primary Schools:

  • St. Lucas Primary School
  • Serenade Road Primary School

Recreational and Leisure Facilities:

  • Halozy Government Building
  • Good Queen Anne Memorial Park

In terms of recreational facilities, Halozy has a track field that can hold regional matches, and a services center featuring self-study rooms, a library, marriage registration offices and a Registration of Persons Offices. In the future, a standard stadium with a 5000-audience capacity and a stadium featuring a tennis court, a squash court, a tennis court and an indoors basketball court will be built.

Major Roads[]

  • Route 7
  • Kallen Road
  • Halozy Road
  • Kiana Road

Transport[]

Nazca Railway[]

  • West Ring Line, Kinight Line Sheung Che Nung Station
  • West Ring Line Kou Fu Sui Station
  • Akashi Line Anne Park Station
  • Akashi Line Red Millet Station
  • Sexterade LRT
    • Sheung Yam Line, Tsing Lam Line Sheung Che Nung Stop
    • Sheung Yam Line Skuld Road Garden Stop
    • Tsing Lam Line Serenade Stop
    • Tsing Lam Line Kou Fu Sui Stop
    • Tsing Lam Line Fu Yi Terrace Stop

Passengers who take Nazca Railway from Halozy can walk to Red Millet Station of Akashi Line, or walk 5 minutes from Exit A of Red Millet Station to Sheung Che Nung Station of West Ring Line, Kinight Line or Sheung Che Nung Stop of Sheung Yam Line, Tsing Lam Line. However, most residents in Halozy use buses as external transport. Under normal circumstances, travelling to Python Delta and Downtown through Routes 4 and 7 takes 8 minutes and 20 minutes respectively.

Future Development[]

Currently, Halozy is still under development, and contains 100-130 thousand people. In the future, Sava Light Transit may be built as a means to diversify demands of travel to other districts. Moreover, plans to turn Java Beach and Comp Ward into a Commercial District may also mean that residents can work in the same district.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station initially began services alongside the rest of the Tokaido Line back in December 24 2017, but due to relocation works of the Peckern Continental Eternity International Airport, as well as development in the vicinity of Grand Junction Station, services to the west of Water Beach Station remained suspended between 2019 and 2020, and the existing structure that belonged to Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu remained disused ever since, hence the reason that this station was not seen as opeartional in this wiki until the arrival of Reiher Line.
  • Currently, while the Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu and Haruna City Railway Structures aren't connected to each other, they still share platform numbers. As a result, the platform numbers of the operational Haruna City Railway Structure starts from 5. This also implies that, after the reconstruction of the Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu Part, an additonal set of platforms will be built for that operator.

Hartasy Line was the eighth line to be established in Nazca Railway Terracept Division. This line ran between Terracept and White Dragon, and had a total of 27 stations. It was established alongside Snowa Island Station on September 5 2013. However, on March 10 2015, Terracept Division ended operations, and this line closed down as a result.

Contents

Description[]

Hartasy Line was the eighth District Railway line in Terracept NR to be established. It traveled from center Terracept Continent and made a detour to the southeast, before returning north and entered the east of Vertin Peninsula and Tropic Continent.

This line was represented by the Orange Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and was Line Number 7.

At the time of its closure, this route was 27.3 km long, with a total of 18 stations.

Fun Facts[]

  • According to the line system map at Terracept Terminal, this line had plans to extend ten more stations from Dragon Spade station, but it never came to fruition due to the closure of Terracept Division.

History[]

  • September 5 2013: Terracept - Surrest
  • May 1 2014: Terracept - Leisura Step
  • June 24 2014: Terracept - White Dragon
  • July 29 2014: Terracept - White Dragon (Kisha Cat Inserted between Snowa Island and Tichim)

Fun Facts[]

  • The English Name of this station derives from the concept of Harvesting, where farmers usually harvest their crops at the end of a Year.[2]
  • The Chinese of the word Year derives from the Nian beast, which appears at the beginning of each year.
  • Black Wool is used in this station as the beginning of each year is at the Midnight of January 1, when the skies are almost always dark. Moreover, the aforementioned Nian beast also almost always appear in the dark.[3]
  • This station is the second of a series of three stations that are built to commemorate a math teacher who taught Railway Builder for a year at SKH Chan Young Secondary School, with the other two stations being Gentle Island Station and Virtel Heights Station.[4][5]
  • As this station is built with the theme of "Harvest" in mind, this station features eight different pieces of farmland, each featuring an item that can be planted on Farmlands, namely Beetroots, Wheat, Pumpkins, Melons, Sugar Canes Cocoa Beans, Carrots and Potatoes.
  • A set of Sidings is availble for Cometsilk Line Trains arriving at this station. However, while the trains arrive and leave the station at the north track and south track respectively, trains arriving from Waterbelt Garden Station and Shadow Shore Station would end up stopping at Platforms 3 and 4 respectively. This ensures that trains would not go back to the station from which it departed.

History[]

  • September 10 2017: This Station completed construction.[6]
  • September 9 2017: This station began services alongside East Ring Line.
  • June 1 2019: This station completed expansion of the Cometsilk Line section.[7]
  • June 2 2019: Cometsilk Line Harvest River branch began services. Cometsilk Line extended from Waterbelt Garden Station and Shadow Shore Station to this station.
